title: Draft Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026 - Money Mule Accounts and Cyber-Enabled Fraud
source_url: Not available in search results - Please refer to RBI official notifications/circulars index
description: <cite index="76-2,76-3">The RBI invited public comments on the draft amendment directions relating to operations of bank accounts and money mule activities, issued pursuant to a Supreme Court order dated August 4, 2026 directing RBI to formulate a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for temporary debit holds on amounts or accounts linked to money mule activity and cyber-enabled financial fraud.</cite> <cite index="77-1">The proposal allows banks to temporarily restrict debit transactions in an account for up to 60 days if it suspects money mule transactions linked to cyber fraud.</cite>
